title: (Deprecated) Supported dimensions
content_data:
A dimension is an attribute to group your data by. Reservation ad reports support the following dimensions. Please note that currently, we don't support all dimensions available on Reservation Ad Platform. # Supported Dimensions ``` xtable | Value {20%} | Description {80%} | | ---- | --- | | advertiser_id | Group by advertiser ID | | campaign_id | Group by campaign ID | | adgroup_id | Group by ad group ID | | ad_id | Group by ad ID

Note: The title for this dimension in the title row of the asynchronous Reservation ad report, after translation, will be `Creative ID`, rather than `Ad ID`.| | stat_time_day | Group by day | | stat_time_hour | Group by hour | | country_code | Group by location code
See [Supported metrics for a dimension in reservation ad reports](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762405922636802) to learn about the supported metrics for this dimension. | ``` # Dimension Grouping The supported dimensions are categorized as ID, time, and location dimensions. - ID dimensions: `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and`ad_id`. - Time dimensions: `stat_time_day` and `stat_time_hour`. - Location dimension: `country_code`. In each request, you can only have **one** ID dimension and **one** time dimension. For example, `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]`. If you want to use location as your grouping filter, you can specify in the `dimensions` field of the request: - `country_code` only, or - `country_code` + **one** ID dimension, or - `country_code` + **one** ID dimension + `stat_time_day`, or - `country_code` + `stat_time_day`.
